title: [SEC4] buildEventsUrl: missing JMAP Session origin documentation
description:
The buildEventsUrl function's comment (lines 51-53) explains what placeholders are replaced but NOT where the template comes from. A maintainer should know:

1. The eventsUrl template is populated from the JMAP Session object returned by /.well-known/jmap (RFC 8620 §2).
2. The placeholder format {types}, {closeafter}, {ping} is defined by RFC 8620 §7.2 (EventSource template).
3. A maintainer should never invent new placeholders without checking RFC 8620 §7.2.

This is a non-obvious invariant that would trip up someone trying to extend the EventSource subscription behavior.
